text: Cute floating island with a tomato garden and a white bunny-like creature. Says Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. Hint says tap the ripe crop - doing that.
Sowed and watered, plants sprouted, now day 3. The creature is called a Momo. Tapping it.
Assigned the Momo to the farm tile, it now says Working at Farm. Other tiles are empty grass so nothing else to assign. Pressing the checkmark.
Momo works the farm on its own now - 5 jobs done, income +9/min. A mail bubble popped up and Mailbox has a red dot. Checking mail.
Cute letter from Momo proposing Field expansion research. I like that the ideas come from the character. Tapping Lets research it.
Research tree with tabs Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 3 flasks and 20 dollars, and I need a research lab first. Tapping Build a research lab.
Build menu: Farm 10 dollars, Mine Lv3, Lumberyard Lv2, Research lab Lv2, Special. Lab is locked until Lv2. I have 40 coins, so building a second farm.
Second farm is ripe but the Momo only tends tile 1. Harvesting it by hand.
Reached Lv2! Momo seems to have walked over to the new farm too. Lv2 should unlock the research lab - tapping an empty grass tile to build one.
Lab is under construction. New hint: tap the glowing sea to grow the island, costs 30. I have 32. Trying it.
Island grew by a tile, lab is built and I have 1 flask now (under the day counter). Momo bounces between lab and farms. Coins down to 11. Dismissing the tip.
One Momo is juggling two farms and a lab. The second farm keeps sitting ripe. Want a second worker - checking the Hire button.
Hiring a Momo costs 90, I only have 23. Need to save. Closing and reading the new mail.
3/3 flasks and 47 coins - Field expansion is ready. Starting research (20s, +1 crop per harvest).
Accidentally selected the Momo instead of the farm. It shows the Momo already looks after 3 tiles (both farms + lab) numbered 1-3, so it was auto-assigned. Farm skill 3, 127 jobs. OK, dismissing.
Field expansion done already! Both farms ripe while Momo works the lab. Deselecting and harvesting by hand.
93 coins! Lv3. Going to hire a second Momo for 90 so the farms dont sit idle.
Hired Mochi! It went to the front farm. Going to use the pencil to also give it the back farm, so the first Momo can focus on research.
Research tree opened up: Watering efficiency (wait after water -25%) is ready, 40 coins, 1m30. Bigger harvests needs 8 flasks. Starting watering efficiency. Income now 114/min.
Found the goal: to become a City I need Land 5/9, Momo 2/3, Research levels 1/3, Value produced 303/1.5K. Clear checklist, nice. Island is called Momonium. Buying more land next (40 per sea tile).
Island now L-shaped, 6 tiles. 97 coins. Checking hire price for the 3rd Momo (city goal).
Hire price went up to 145, have 121. Will wait a bit. Meanwhile looking at what I can build on the empty center tile.
Build menu now: Farm 10, Mine 120 + Wood 10 (so I need a lumberyard first, 80), Lab 40, Special 0/1. Curious what Special is.
Special = landmarks: Clock Tower Lv5, School Lv4, Momo Monument Lv6. Not yet. 187 coins - hiring the 3rd Momo first (145) since any new building would need hands.
Hired Pomu, City goal now 1/4. 10 flasks banked and Research has a red dot - going for Bigger harvests.
Lv4 now, research 2 done and Bigger harvests running. 3 Momos busy. Building a cheap 3rd farm on the empty front tile so Pomu has more to do.
Changed my mind - 120 coins, going for a Lumberyard (80) instead since wood unlocks the Mine.
Lumberyard is up with a little tree, wood counter appeared (2 wood). A Momo already chops there. Now buying the next sea tile for the Land goal.
Bought another tile (55). Island keeps snaking out. The Momo at the lab has a ... speech bubble - tapping it to see what it wants.
The bubble vanished before I could read it, I just selected the lab (Experiment 2s). 121 coins - trying for one more land tile at the bottom.
Land 8 now. New mail arrived. Reading it.
Letter from Mochi this time - Tree nursery proposal. Nice that each Momo writes. Accepting and checking status to see City progress.
City checklist: Land 8/9, Momo done, Research 2/3, Value 827/1.5K. One more land tile would tick another box. 157 coins - going for it.
Bought the 9th tile for 90 - Land goal should be done. About a minute left; going to queue up the next research.
City 3/4! Land and research levels must both be done now. Only value produced left. Opening research for one more upgrade.
Started Greenhouse research (120). Income 216/min, City 3/4 with only Value produced left. I would keep going to become a City.
